Business_Description: High-value, highly active customers with high spend, frequent orders, and very recent purchases. They represent the core revenue engine and brand advocates.
Recommended_Action: Reward with exclusive VIP perks, early access to new product drops, personalized thank-you notes, and referral incentives. Avoid aggressive discounts.
Preferred_Channel: Direct VIP concierge email, dedicated SMS alerts, exclusive loyalty portal.
Target_KPIs: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), Net Promoter Score (NPS), Referral Rate, Share of Wallet.

Business_Description: High total monetary spend and large basket values, but lower order frequency. Likely bulk purchasers, gift buyers, or business clients.
Recommended_Action: Offer volume-tier wholesale pricing, dedicated account management, bulk reorder subscriptions, and seasonal pre-order catalogs.
Preferred_Channel: B2B sales outreach, tailored email catalogs, invoiced payment terms.
Target_KPIs: Average Order Value (AOV), Units per Transaction (UPT), Reorder Interval.

Business_Description: Consistent, trustworthy repeat buyers with steady purchase cadence and moderate-to-high basket sizes. High brand affinity.
Recommended_Action: Enroll in tiered loyalty/rewards programs. Upsell complementary product bundles and cross-sell trending categories with personalized recommendations.
Preferred_Channel: Weekly curated email digests, in-app push notifications, targeted social retargeting.
Target_KPIs: Repeat Purchase Rate, Average Order Value (AOV), Category Cross-Purchase Rate.

Business_Description: Recently acquired customers with 1-2 purchases and positive basket sizes. In the critical onboarding window.
Recommended_Action: Deploy automated welcome onboarding email drip series, provide second-purchase incentives with expiration urgency (e.g. 15% off next 14 days), and educational product guides.
Preferred_Channel: Onboarding email journey, browser push, welcome SMS.
Target_KPIs: First-to-Second Purchase Conversion Rate, Time-to-Second Order, Unsubscribe Rate.

Business_Description: Infrequent buyers with very high recency (long inactivity) and low overall spend. Lowest response probability.
Recommended_Action: Low-cost programmatic re-engagement or seasonal clearance campaigns. Suppress from expensive paid channels to protect ROI and sender reputation.
Preferred_Channel: Automated bi-monthly clearance newsletters, low-cost programmatic retargeting.
Target_KPIs: Reactivation ROI, List Hygiene / Bounce Rate, Unsubscribe Rate.
